preconditions.description: The length of array A is between 1 and 100.
Each string in array A has a length between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in array A is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A[i]) == len(A[0]) for i in range(1, len(A)))
preconditions.description: All strings in array A have the same length.

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of columns to delete.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i][j] <= A[i][j+1] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[i]) - 1))
postconditions.description: After deleting the specified columns, all rows in the array A are lexicographically sorted.
